title: Mortgage & Development Finance Calculator UK
summary: Page body was not retrievable (direct fetch blocked; the URL-exact search [a] did not surface the page). Search [b] confirmed the page exists with the SERP title 'Mortgage & Development Finance Calculator UK' and summarised it as a tool for estimating borrowing capacity, loan terms and repayments for commercial and development finance deals across the UK: the user picks a project type and a loan type (seed adds loan size and term) and the tool shows how many lenders might back the project. Search [c] returned no Silver Oak Capital results at all. No form field labels, output format, lender names, rates or H1/meta text were revealed. Related leverage benchmarks surfaced from sibling pages (first-time developer 60-65% LTGDV max; stretch senior ~90% LTC cap; residential 75% LTGDV / 90% LTC) are recorded as context, not as calculator content.

Search (c) (standard) returned zero Silver Oak Capital results; all hits were unrelated third parties (Commercial Trust, Swoop, Capitalise, Oblix, etc.) and nothing from them was recorded.
